title: Mutant Dungeons Creeper Resource Pack
description: As you can tell by the name, this resource pack changes the regular (to be honest, ugly) mutant creepers texture to be more in line with the textures of MC Dungeons.
body:
This resource pack changes not only the Mutant Creeper, but its egg after it dies. 

_Please note that I **DID NOT** touch the creeper minion texture as it uses the texture of **ANY** resource pack that changes the creepers texture. This texture pack should be used with the Dungeons Creeper resource pack_.



[Mutant Monsters Mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mutant-monsters) by Fuzs

[Dungeons Creeper Resource Pack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/dungeons-creeper) by Pr3tty_B0y



Please **DONT** download this pack from anywhere that isnt Curseforge or Modrinth as you could be downloading something potentially harmful. Remember to stay safe and dont download any suspicious files.
